VertexOut and the body are supplied because the issue\0D\0A// elides them and calls their layout unimportant; the output members are named\0D\0A// oPosH/oColor so that no output identifier is a substring of an input one.\0D\0A//\0D\0A// The constant buffer is the deliberate addition.
